content.title: Shrinking season 4 is confirmed despite season 3 finale feeling like the end: "We've told the story"
content.text: Shrinking season 3 finale spoilers follow.Shrinking season four was recently confirmed despite the show initially having a three-season plan, and co-creator Bill Lawrence has now opened up about its continuation. The Apple TV show wrapped its third run today, with the finale now available to stream.Fans would be forgiven for feeling like it's a series finale, with the episode seeing therapist Jimmy (Jason Segel) moving forward amid his grief for his late wife by pursuing a relationship with Sofi (Cobie Smulders). Additionally, daughter Alice (Lukita Maxwell American) moves to college in Connecticut, while Paul (Harrison Ford) also relocates with his wife to the state.Apple TVRelated: Best streaming servicesLawrence has now reflected on initially pitching the show as three seasons to steamer Apple TV, confirming to The Hollywood Reporter that "this is the end of that story"."This is the finale of that three-season story," he explained. "And I hope that people will dig it that when we come back, whether there’s a time jump or not, that they’ll feel like we’re telling a completely different story."What to Read NextHe added: "We’ve told [...] the story of whether or not Jason Segel’s Jimmy is going to make it through the death of his wife and come out the other side as someone who might be able to find joy and happiness in his life again."Advertisement - Continue Reading BelowWith the cast all back in tow, including Ford, he teased some of the potential storylines to come, the show boss noting that it's "not an accident that Alice goes to school at Wesleyan University" and that she's seen "going by to have dinner at Paul’s house".Apple TV"Time passage changes a lot of things – as to where people are, where they’re living and how things have progressed," he said.Lawrence continued: "I don’t want to spoil too much, but we’ve always done a couple month jump from season to season, at most, because we have these continual stories."One of the funny things for us was to say that it’s like Groundhog Day. If anybody took the time to look at how long the show was, the show always takes place over like three weeks or a month. So this [jump to season four] will definitely be significant and beyond a year or two."Shrinking seasons 1-3 are streaming now on Apple TV.The new edition of Living Legends, a 100-page all-colour celebration of Sir David Attenborough, is here!
